data.one_liner: Intent-based router for Flutter with deep linking and nested navigation.
data.what_it_does: DuckRouter lets you define routes as intent classes, providing type-safe navigation and interceptors for pre-navigation logic. It supports dynamic route registration, deep linking, and nested navigation out of the box.
use_when: You need type-safe, intent-based routing with deep linking support
You want to add authentication or feature-flag interceptors
You require nested navigation without boilerplate
avoid_when: You prefer a code-generation based router like auto_route
You need extensive custom page transition animations not covered by DuckRouter
strengths: Type-safe intent classes reduce navigation errors
Built-in interceptors simplify auth and feature-flag flows
Dynamic registry allows routes to be added at runtime
Supports deep linking and nested navigation
weaknesses: Documentation is limited compared to go_router
Custom page transitions may require extra work
data.setup_notes: Add DuckRouter to MaterialApp.router and call DuckRouter.of(context).navigate()

alternatives.name: go_router
alternatives.why_pick_it: Popular, well-documented, supports code generation and extensive customizations
